options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: exclusion_id
options.description: The id of the exclusion. Use the module list_exclusions to list all the exclusions.

options.name: members
options.description: The targets that you want excluded from scans. Specify multiple targets as a comma-separated string. Targets can be in the following formats IPv4 address, range of IPv4 addresses, CIDR notation, or a FQDN. Target example an individual IPv4 address 192.0.2.1 Target example a range of IPv4 addresses 192.0.2.1-192.0.2.255 Target example a CIDR notation 192.0.2.0/24 Target example a fully-qualified domain name FQDN host.domain.com

options.name: network_id
options.description: The UUID of the network object you want to update. You cannot update the default network object. To list all networks and get the ID use the list_networks moduke.

options.name: schedule
options.description: The schedule parameters for the exclusion.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.
